_description: Intent vocabulary for HandsFree fuzzy matching.
_usage: The LevenshteinMatcher compares normalized English input against these entries.
_maintainers: Add common phrasings you encounter during testing.

APP_LAUNCH.action: Launches an app by package name or common name

SMART_SEARCH.action: Types a query into the active search field

MESSAGING.action: Opens messaging app and composes a message

CALL_ACCEPT.action: Accepts or declines an incoming call

SCHEDULING.action: Creates, reads, or checks reminders and alarms via Android system APIs

NAVIGATION.action: General UI navigation commands (scroll, swipe, tap grid coordinates)
